# Xiaomi Global
> Xiaomi Global is the official international website for Xiaomi phones, wearables, smart home devices, lifestyle products, and customer support resources.

Xiaomi Global provides product discovery, support documentation, warranty information, compliance materials, and corporate information for Xiaomi’s international markets.

## Product Categories
- [Mobile](https://www.mi.com/global/mobile/): Browse Xiaomi and Redmi smartphones available on the global site.
- [Wearables](https://www.mi.com/global/wearables/): Explore smart bands, smartwatches, and other wearable devices.
- [Smart Home](https://www.mi.com/global/smart-home/): Discover connected home devices, appliances, and smart ecosystem products.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.mi.com/global/life-style/): View personal electronics and everyday lifestyle accessories.
- [Discover](https://www.mi.com/global/discover/): Read featured stories, product highlights, and Xiaomi ecosystem content.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.mi.com/global/support/): Access Xiaomi customer support resources, help topics, and service information.
- [Contact Us](https://www.mi.com/global/support/contact/): Find official customer service contact options for Xiaomi Global.
- [User Guide](https://www.mi.com/global/support/user-guide/): Search and access product manuals and user documentation.
- [Warranty](https://www.mi.com/global/support/warranty/): Review warranty terms and service coverage information.
- [International Warranty](https://www.mi.com/global/support/xiaomi-iws/): Learn about Xiaomi international warranty service eligibility and scope.
- [Scooter Safety Notice](https://www.mi.com/global/support/scooter-safety-notice/): Read official safety notices related to Xiaomi scooter products.

## Enterprise and Regulatory
- [Android Enterprise Recommended](https://www.mi.com/global/support/android-enterprise-recommended/): View Xiaomi devices recognized for Android enterprise deployment.
- [EU Declaration of Conformity](https://www.mi.com/global/service/support/declaration.html): Access regulatory conformity declarations for applicable Xiaomi products.
- [Digital Services Act](https://www.mi.com/global/support/policy/digital-service-act/): Review Xiaomi’s Digital Services Act policy information.
- [Data Act](https://www.mi.com/global/support/documents/data-act/): Read Xiaomi documentation related to the Data Act.

## Community and Content
- [Community](https://new.c.mi.com/global?utm_source=mistore&utm_medium=official_web_tabcommunity&utm_campaign=official_web_mistore_global/?t=1): Join Xiaomi’s global community discussions, announcements, and user engagement.
- [Discover](https://www.mi.com/global/discover/): Explore editorial content, launches, and ecosystem stories from Xiaomi.

## Corporate Information
- [About Xiaomi](https://www.mi.com/global/about/): Learn about Xiaomi’s company background, mission, and global business.
- [Leadership Team](https://www.mi.com/global/about/founder/): Meet Xiaomi leadership and founder-related company information.

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.mi.com/global/about/privacy/): Review Xiaomi’s privacy practices and personal data handling policy.
- [Digital Services Act](https://www.mi.com/global/support/policy/digital-service-act/): Access policy information relevant to platform compliance obligations.
- [Data Act](https://www.mi.com/global/support/documents/data-act/): Review Xiaomi’s published information concerning Data Act requirements.
